items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He was good. Vic was good. He was out at Tranchines with them for 35 years.

ctx.x: And, uh... How did Oak...not Oak...Vick Gaspar. Was he a good one? Vic Gaspar. Was he a good one?
He was good. Vic was good. He was out at Tranchines with them for 35 years. Was there all that time too. And Cantrell was just as good as a drummer.
Time keepers you could lay your eyes on.
